task.title: M2: codeviz serve with node:http server and embedded UI assets
task.description:
Implement codeviz serve: a node:http server bound to localhost that exposes the cached snapshots for the current repo and hosts the built web UI from assets embedded in the bundle. Endpoints: GET /api/snapshots lists cached SHAs with ref names, analyzedAt, toolVersion and language tiers; GET /api/snapshots/:sha returns one snapshot (gzip-encoded when the client accepts it). Snapshots analyzed for WORKTREE are held in memory and listed with sha 'WORKTREE'. The server must use only node:* APIs so it runs under Node 20.

Acceptance criteria:
- codeviz serve prints a localhost URL, opens it with --open, and serves the UI shell at /.
- GET /api/snapshots returns the cached list plus git branches and tags with their resolved SHAs, so the client can show unanalyzed refs.
- GET /api/snapshots/:sha returns 404 for unknown SHAs and the snapshot JSON otherwise, with Content-Encoding: gzip when accepted.
- UI assets are embedded in the single ESM bundle (or a sibling asset dir shipped in the npm package) and served with correct MIME types.
- Integration test boots the server on an ephemeral port under Node 20 and asserts both endpoints.
